selection_policy: Install and author only the minimum products needed to cover real project roles. Famous alternatives are deferred until a measured capability gap appears.

project_evidence.interpretation_correction: Plugin names embedded in rendered WAV filenames describe processing printed by the source engineer. They are not evidence that Vit should install or prioritize those products.

minimum_complete_chain.preferred_first_product: FabFilter Pro-Q (one locally licensed version only)
minimum_complete_chain.reason: Universal corrective, tonal and dynamic EQ for all observed track roles. Product choice is based on broad use and coverage, not printed source-track names.
One flexible compressor can cover drums, bass, vocals, instruments and buses before authoring character alternatives.
A widely used, focused reverb product gives the first suite vendor diversity and covers the principal algorithmic reverb spaces.
A widely used delay with timing, feedback, stereo and style behavior exercises a different vendor surface and special capabilities.
Required for output safety and loudness-stage experiments.
Second-batch addition for the substantial lead/backing vocal material when dynamic EQ is not the preferred workflow.
Second-batch addition for a focused, widely used harmonic-color workflow; a multiband saturation product is deferred until needed.

deferred_until_real_gap.gap: multiband dynamics cannot be achieved adequately by current EQ/compressor capabilities
a specific character, detector behavior or time-constant workflow is requested; CLA-76 is the first candidate
the user explicitly wants the composite vendor workflow and its special capabilities

authority: No entry is a VPS, Credential or Catalog capability until the locally installed version and format pass human semantic witness, conformance and FXM evidence requirements.
